title: India refrains from reacting to Bangladesh PM Rahman's 'across the border' jibe over protests

ai.summary: Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman made controversial remarks about protests in India during a public event in northern Bangladesh, but India has not publicly responded to the comments.

facts.claim: Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman made controversial remarks about protests in India during a public event in northern Bangladesh
facts.quote: Rahman had made the controversial remarks while addressing a public event at Lalmonirhat in northern Bangladesh on Thursday.
